phases.objective: Provide a separately authorized, exact-once Migration 1043 Apply contract that requires pre-existing Runtime Readiness authorization, exact Production parity, readback-first duplicate prevention, a same-cycle zero-risk dry-run, one non-retriable Apply attempt, and exact ledger/readiness certification without synchronizing the activation registry.

e2e_journeys.actor: Authorized repository operator reviewing the Migration 1043 Apply boundary
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Static Apply workflow, executor, and exact-trigger contract
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The repository exposes one exact issue-comment-gated Apply path that fails closed unless Runtime Readiness authorization already exists, revalidates the reviewed migration and exact Production runtime, performs readback and a same-cycle dry-run before one Apply request, never retries ambiguous execution, and requires exact ledger and readiness-view certification afterward.
steps: Require the exact Apply comment on issue #4449 from an OWNER, MEMBER, or COLLABORATOR.
Reject push, pull_request, workflow_dispatch, and automatic Apply triggers.
Checkout trusted main and verify it contains repository readiness, runtime-readiness contract, recovery, and projection/reconciliation merges.
Verify the protected Production ref contains the managed-execution foundation and the exact reviewed Migration 1043 Git blob.
Require health, version, and deployment-info to converge on one stable protected Production SHA.
Perform governed migration ledger/schema readback before creating an execution envelope or sending Apply.
If the exact Apply ledger already exists and all expected objects/readiness checks pass, report already_applied and send no Apply.
Otherwise read the exact governed migration authorization registry row and prove Runtime Readiness already authorized the reviewed checksum, statement count, source PR, and source merge.
Never create or rotate readiness authorization from the Apply contract.
Repeat the zero-risk governed dry-run in the same workflow execution.
Create and apply-authorize one Production- and checksum-bound governed_migration_execute envelope with external writes disabled.
Send exactly one Apply request using the filename-derived confirmation and never retry an unsuccessful or ambiguous response.
Require exact Apply ledger, expected table/view objects, and a one-row readiness view reporting 3/3 tables, 15/15 binding columns, and readiness_status=ready.
Upload sanitized Artifact and Job Summary evidence without GitHub writes or activation registry synchronization.
assertions: The workflow trigger is exactly APPLY_1043_SPRINT69_TENANT_MANAGED_EXECUTION_LIFECYCLE on issue #4449 and differs from the Runtime Readiness trigger.
The workflow has contents:read only and no push, pull_request, workflow_dispatch, Issue write, PR write, or repository mutation permission.

The executor pins Migration 1043 blob 7f3e0152bcdfba36a659ff4a1df8e30d82024c8c, checksum a11dff751fca4df19a6acfc188ca7310d8e1a90aa5c3f06fe0c3efeb1213a2a9, four statements, source PR #4845, and source merge a1c1f3d4f4b36a3a5764d898194818e3e9ea1ce3.

The Apply contract never creates readiness authorization; it requires exactly one authorized governed_migration_authorization_registry row with matching policy, source, checksum, statement count, source PR, source merge, zero-risk preflight, and allow_apply=1.
Readback-first prevents duplicate Apply when the exact ledger and expected objects already exist.
The same-cycle dry-run reports mode=dry_run, applies_sql=false, exact checksum and statement count, preflight pass, and zero risks.
The execution envelope requires explicit apply authorization under governed_migration_execute_apply_v1 and external_write_allowed=false.
The executor contains exactly one mode=apply request and never retries Apply after an unsuccessful or ambiguous response.
An ambiguous Apply response records apply_sent=true, retry_permitted=false, and requires exact readback before any future operator decision.
Success requires exact Apply ledger metadata, all three tables, the readiness view, and readiness counts/status.
The contract never calls activation_authorized_surface_registry_sync and reports activation_registry_sync_executed=false.
No provider call, credential payload read, external business write, deployment, Production ref mutation, or secret evidence occurs during contract validation.

phases.objective: After successful Runtime Readiness and a separate exact Apply comment, execute one Apply attempt and retain exact authorization, dry-run, ledger, object, and readiness-view Artifacts.

Prove ambiguous-response handling, duplicate-ledger reuse, stale authorization rejection, checksum drift rejection, Production drift rejection, and no-retry behavior against controlled non-production fixtures.
Verify persistent managed execution tables and tenant/admin projection/reconciliation paths against a non-production database after the exact migration ledger is present.
Promote and verify the exact implementation SHA, separately synchronize the tenant-safe activation surface, execute protected tenant/admin canaries, and complete the final #4449 audit.
